title: Velvety American Pork Back Ribs Casserole
description: A comforting American dish featuring pork back ribs in a rich and velvety sauce, perfect for a cold winter night, halal-friendly and steam-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, combine the pork back ribs, onion, and garlic.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the barbecue sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce mixture over the pork and onions, covering the pot with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and steam-cook for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the ribs hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
